def transform(grid):
    # Copy the motif in the top-left compartment horizontally across the divider,
    # preserving the divider lines; demonstrated layout repeats pattern every 5 cols.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # infer separators as most common non-background row/column lines, then repeat tile
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v != bg for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if not sep_rows and not sep_cols: return out
    # Build each open cell block; repeat first block's contents to other blocks of same size.
    rbounds=[-1]+sep_rows+[h]; cbounds=[-1]+sep_cols+[w]
    blocks=[]
    for i in range(len(rbounds)-1):
      for j in range(len(cbounds)-1):
        rs=list(range(rbounds[i]+1,rbounds[i+1])); cs=list(range(cbounds[j]+1,cbounds[j+1]))
        if rs and cs: blocks.append((i,j,rs,cs))
    # In demo, 4x4 motif repeats horizontally; replicate first block pattern to later column blocks.
    # Here single separator cross, copy upper-left quadrant across right and lower-left down.
    for i,j,rs,cs in blocks:
      if i==0 and j==0: continue
      for a,r in enumerate(rs):
        for b,c in enumerate(cs):
          sr=blocks[0][2][a%len(blocks[0][2])]; sc=blocks[0][3][b%len(blocks[0][3])]
          if grid[sr][sc]!=bg: out[r][c]=grid[sr][sc]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg), None)
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                        and grid[0][c] != bg), None)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    tile_h = divider_row if divider_row is not None else h
    tile_w = divider_col if divider_col is not None else w
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if divider_row is not None and r == divider_row:
                continue
            if divider_col is not None and c == divider_col:
                continue
            if r >= tile_h or c >= tile_w:
                source_r = r if r < tile_h else (r - tile_h - 1) % tile_h
                source_c = c if c < tile_w else (c - tile_w - 1) % tile_w
                value = grid[source_r][source_c]
                if value != bg:
                    out[r][c] = value
    return out
PY
